name: Estun Codroid C05-L
summary: A light wheeled humanoid (32 kg, 16 DOF) with two arms, optional dexterous hands and a head camera module, for material handling, line inspection and service tasks in factories.

germany.statusNote: RBTX (igus, Germany) lists the ESTUN C05-L with a contact button instead of a price and a usual delivery time of 3 weeks.

sellers.name: RBTX marketplace (igus SE & Co. KG)
sellers.note: Article RBTX-ESTU-0003; no price shown, "Kontaktieren Sie uns" and "Übliche Lieferzeit: 3 Wochen". The category list shows it as "Auf Anfrage".

specs.label: Max payload
specs.conditions: not split per arm on the page

specs.label: Battery
specs.quote: Powered by a 15Ah battery with harmonic reducers

specs.label: Interfaces
specs.value: 1x HDMI, 2x USB 3.0, 3x Ethernet, emergency stop; open EtherCAT slave configuration
specs.quote: The back shell has 1×HDMI, 2×USB 3.0, 3×Ethernet ports, a 30mm through hole and 1×emergency stop interface.

notes: Dexterous hands are an option: "optional arm-mounted dexterous hand (mounting flange, DC 24V/2.5A, RS-485)".
The 10 kg payload is not split per arm, so no per-arm figure is set.

evidence.task: Material handling, production line inspection, material distribution and commercial guidance
evidence.note: Seller description names auto-parts workshops and electronics assembly; no construction or prefab use reported.

sources.title: 磐石C05-L 柔性全场景机器人

openQuestions: The maker page (codroid.ai) carries its specs only in images; all figures here come from RBTX.
Per-arm payload, arm DOF split and price are not stated.
RBTX spells the model CO5-L in the URL and title and C05-L in the text; the maker writes C05-L.
